user_query: I'm organizing a charity auction and I want to generate barcodes for the auction items. Can you use the Barcode API to create barcodes for each item? Please provide me with the barcode images. Additionally, I need to track the delivery status of the auction items. Can you use the E-commerce Delivery Status API to check the current location of the packages?

TaskList.description: Generate barcodes for each auction item using the Barcode API.
Retrieve the barcode images generated for each auction item.
Check the current location of the packages using the E-commerce Delivery Status API.
